failure.location: select_six_photos after a group had passed the frozen >=6 photo and >=3 observer support rule
failure.cause: the support rule does not logically guarantee that six rows can be selected while also enforcing the separately frozen maximum of two photos per observer; for example observer counts 4+1+1 pass >=6 photos and >=3 observers but have capped capacity 2+1+1=4
failure.observed_exception: RuntimeError: qualified support group could not supply exact six-photo round-robin sample

correction.rule: before a group may count as an executable qualifying support group, require sum_over_observers(min(distinct_photos_for_observer, 2)) >= 6 in addition to all original frozen group conditions
correction.effect_direction: fail_closed_only; this rule can remove groups or species but can never add support relative to the frozen spatial gate
correction.species_rule: the existing >=3 groups and >=500 km centroid-separation rule is then evaluated on executable qualifying groups so every selected species can actually produce the frozen six-photo-per-group manifest without violating the observer cap
